tagline: A wall on every side to lean into, and a low front they can step over.
lead: Your dog gets a surround to press into whichever way they turn, and a low front step that's easy at any age.
value: The lowered front keeps this bed useful for years, because a full wall is what an older, stiffer dog quietly stops climbing.
intro: Holly is an orthopaedic dog sofa bed with a profiled egg-crate foam base, a bolster on all four sides, a lowered front entry, a soft flannel cover, a waterproof liner around the foam and a non-slip base.
points: Something to lean into whichever way they turn in the night.
The entry section is dropped, so getting in and out is easy at any age.
Egg-crate foam that spreads their weight rather than compressing flat.
A waterproof liner around the foam, flannel on top and a non-slip base underneath.
best_for: Small and medium dogs who like walls around them, including older dogs who find a full-height wall hard to step over.
fit_note: The bolsters take up part of the outside size, so measure your dog curled up as well as stretched out. Between Medium and Large? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Remove the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Wipe the liner. Air-dry fully before refitting, and never wash or soak the foam.
seo_title: Orthopaedic Dog Sofa Bed with Low Front Step | Snoozly
seo_description: An orthopaedic dog sofa bed with walls on all four sides and a low front step. Egg-crate foam, waterproof liner and soft flannel cover. Medium and Large.
